name: Slime
description: Oozes closer, then can leap along a line for a crushing slam.

name: Skeleton
description: Rattling bones armed with a random weapon.

name: Skeleton Archer
description: Keeps distance with a bow — loads, then fires in straight lines.

name: Mimic
description: Disguised as a chest until disturbed.

name: Douvlon
description: A paired threat — red and blue share one life; the line between them cuts deep.

name: Mystic Core
description: A floating crystal that strikes at range or slips away.

name: Rockling
description: A stony brute with a tough hide.
